loginHeadline: The quiet control room behind every chat.
loginLede: Connection, commands, memory, and moderation stay together—on your server and within reach.
loginSub: Sign in to manage your {brand} workspace.
resetSubtitle: {brand} sends a one-time code to your WhatsApp — the linked account's own chat. The code works for 10 minutes.
resetSubtitleChannels: {brand} can send a one-time code to WhatsApp, or to your recovery email. The code works for 10 minutes.
resetErrThrottled: Too many requests. Try again in {n} seconds.
resetErrNoSession: WhatsApp isn't connected, so the code can't be sent. Sign in on the server and run `levix reset-password`, or start the WhatsApp session first.
resetErrSendFailed: Couldn't send the WhatsApp message. Try again in a minute.
resetErrUnverified: The recovery email has to be verified again in Settings. Use WhatsApp or run `levix reset-password` on the server.
resetErrLocked: Too many wrong codes today, so reset is paused. Try again later, or run `levix reset-password` on the server.
resetErrRateLimited: The mail service is busy. Try again in a little while.
resetErrUnavailable: Couldn't reach the mail service. Try again.
resetErrInvalid: The mail service rejected the request.
resetErrStart: Couldn't start the reset. Try again.
resetErrServer: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
resetDone: Password updated. Taking you to sign in…
resetErrExpired: That code is no longer valid. Send a new one.
resetErrFailed: Couldn't reset the password. Try again.
setupLede: Choose one strong password, then manage the assistant from a single private control room.
setupSub: Protect the linked WhatsApp account with at least {n} characters.
setupCodeHint: Confirms you can access the server running {brand}.
qrLede: One scan securely links {brand} to the WhatsApp account you choose.
qrStep1: Open WhatsApp on the phone the bot should use.
qrStep2: Choose Settings → Linked devices → Link a device.
qrCallout: No code yet? Press Start session on the dashboard's Connection screen.
qrNotStarted: Not started — start it from the dashboard
tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again later.
invalidPassword: Password must be at least {n} characters
